violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Red curry, Green curry.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: a variety of ground spices stored in unmarked containers without labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cooking & Baking Equipment, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The cavity,) of the microwave oven was observed soiled.
violations.corrective_action: The interiors of all microwave ovens including cavities, door seals, floors, walls, and ceilings shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: A variety of liquids ion squeeze bottles, powders, ground/pasty foods that are not easy to identify were noted in unmarked containments without labels.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. AFTER EACH USE PLACE THE WET /DAMP TOWELS IN THE SANITIZING SOLUTION. DO NOT LEAVE THEM ON WORK TABLES. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Ice scoops were found stored on cloth table liner near the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: After each use, place the ice scoops on a scoop dispenser that is installed on the ice machine, or in a cleaned and sanitize surface, or in an ice bucket, BANGKOK STREET RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 07/10/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact exterior surfaces of the cooking equipment including the pipping attached, located under the hood system, have accumulations of excess grease build-up, grime and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CLEAN THESE SURFACES PROPERLY AND MORE FREQUENTLY TO PREVENT T DIRT BUILDUP.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the piping under a sink, at the dish washing area, are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. REPAIR THIS LEAKY PIPE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the exterior surfaces of the grease trap located next to the cooking equipment at the hood system area, are in need of cleaning. The floors under equipment such as refrigerators, storage shelves, under stove, wok, and grill at the hood station, are also in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CLEAN THESE SURFACES THOROUGHLY AND MORE OFTEN. CLEAN THE FLOORS PROPERLY UNDER THESE EQUIPMENT.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC COULD NOT PRODUCE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. PIC WILL PRINT EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY AND HAVE ALL EMPLOYEES READ AND SIGN. PIC WILL PROVIDE EHS WITH PROOF OF SIGNED EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY NO LATER THAN MONDAY, JANUARY 13TH.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: EHS OBSERVED RAW SQUID OVER SAUCE IN 2DR PREP TOP COOLER FRONT, AND RAW SHELL EGGS OVER COOKED NOODLES IN 2DR UPRIGHT COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLERS SUCH THAT RAW FOODS WERE BELOW RTE FOODS.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS. EHS OBSERVED GARLIC MANUFACTURERS CONTAINERS USED FOR THE STORAGE OF VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS IN ALL COOLERS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC WILL OBTAIN SUFFICIENT, APPROVED STORAGE FOR ALL FOOD ITEMS. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. BANGKOK STREET RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 01/10/2025) Page 2 of 3
